annotations.title: Create or replace a ChatGPT Ads Business Agent

description: Draft a ChatGPT Ads BUSINESS AGENT: name, instructions (the system prompt real users will experience — write it as the brand), optional description, privacy policy URL, conversation starters, product feed ids, connector ids, tool ids (list_openai_ads_business_agent_tools) and a published lead form id. Pass businessAgentId to REPLACE an existing agent’s configuration (it becomes a pending change). Nothing is served until publish_openai_ads_business_agent. Needs ChatGPT Ads connected.

businessAgentId.description: replace THIS agent’s configuration instead of creating a new one

connectorIds.description: connector ids the agent may use

conversationStarters.description: suggested opening questions shown to users

instructions.description: system prompt that users experience, written in the brand's voice

leadFormId.description: published lead form id the agent collects leads with

privacyPolicyUrl.description: privacy policy URL shown with the agent

productFeedIds.description: product feed ids the agent may draw on, from list_openai_ads_feeds

toolIds.description: tool ids the agent may use, from list_openai_ads_business_agent_tools

name: create_openai_ads_business_agent
title: Create or replace a ChatGPT Ads Business Agent
